items.title_fr: “30th Celebration” Pull Rates and Most Valuable Cards Worldwide: Friendliest Pull Rates of the Modern Era!
items.summary_fr: The pull rates for 30th Celebration have been determined by our friends at TCGplayer after opening 3,000 English booster packs. As expected, like 2021's Celebrations, the set gives fans easy access to most rarities -- making it a true celebration! The set's Special Illustration Rares are 4x easier to pull than those from recent sets, at 1 in 21 booster packs (in Pitch Black it was 1 in 80).

items.title_fr: Rare Co-Founder Tim Stamper Unveils A Treasure Trove Of Conker Dev Material
items.summary_fr: Let's dive in. Rare co-founder Tim Stamper has begun uploading new videos to his YouTube channel ' InTimsWorld ', the first of which being a deep dive into the development of Conker's Bad Fur Day (thanks, Time Extension ). Released in 2001, mere months before the GameCube landed, Conker's Bad Fur Day is one of the most recognisable titles on the N64, garnering critical acclaim and controversy in equal measure thanks to its raunchy themes and platforming satire.
